items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Sam Utterback as a trumpet player in the band, but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of interaction, or specific relationship detail.

ctx.x: Well, I mean who else was in that, Joe?
Les, I can't remember Les' last name but there was a trumpet player and he played the English horn by the name of Sam Utterback.
